missing_cover.question: ถ้าบทความไม่มีรูปปก ให้จัดการอย่างไร
missing_cover.decision: Do not display that story on Home

featured_replacement.question: กรณีเรื่องเด่นไม่มีปก
featured_replacement.decision: Promote next ready story preserving curated order, without duplication

temporary_cover_load_failure.trigger: Cover load has failed; loading alone is not failure
temporary_cover_load_failure.decision: Skip affected story in current Home display and promote next ready story in existing order without duplicates

other_incomplete_fields.missing_required_field: Exclude story from Home and apply existing ordered promotion and fallback rules
other_incomplete_fields.missing_excerpt: Use text taken from the content of that same actual article, maximum two lines with ellipsis, for featured and supporting stories; no invented sample copy or AI summary
other_incomplete_fields.missing_excerpt_revision: Owner requested body text during R1; supersedes the earlier Q3 omission treatment only
other_incomplete_fields.actual_article_source: Not required for current mock Home design; future real snippets must come from that article body; article feature remains unstarted

article_list_loading_and_error.owner_quote: โอเคตกลงแบบนี้แหละ
article_list_loading_and_error.loading: Section-local light skeleton with space close to expected composition
article_list_loading_and_error.request_failure: Hide whole optional article section in the described failure case; no error notice, retry control or refresh prompt; other ready sections remain usable
article_list_loading_and_error.successful_empty_result: Hide section under confirmed zero-story rule
article_list_loading_and_error.internal_logging: Future internal technical logging requirement only; not implemented

curated_set_empty_fallback.owner_quote: ใช้บทความล่าสุดไง
curated_set_empty_fallback.trigger: No eligible stories remain in the curated set
curated_set_empty_fallback.decision: Use latest eligible stories with covers, newest first
curated_set_empty_fallback.layout: First as featured, following stories as supporting; existing composition preserved
curated_set_empty_fallback.date_field: Last edited timestamp, descending; owner confirmed in Q6; actual data contract not verified

curated_set_top_up.trigger: One or two eligible curated stories remain
curated_set_top_up.curated_priority: Keep curated stories first in existing order
curated_set_top_up.top_up_source: Other eligible articles ordered by last edited timestamp descending under Q6
curated_set_top_up.insufficient_candidates: Display available count using accepted one-story or two-story layout

entire_catalog_empty.trigger: No eligible stories exist across the entire catalog, including latest fallback
entire_catalog_empty.decision: Hide the entire Home article section, including its heading and section spacing; adjacent sections flow together using normal page spacing

count_layout_proposal.zero: Hide entire section only when no eligible catalog stories exist
